problem:
$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrix above. Find its decomposition using Jordan blocks.
worked_solution:
Our matrix can be represented as a single Jordan block:

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & 1 & 0 \\ 0 & 5 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 5\end{aligned}]={J}_{3}(5)
$$
